excerpt.en: Produced by Skydance Sports and Netflix Sports, “Rafa,” a four-part portrait of Spain’s greatest sports icon Rafael Nadal, packs several singular punches. Also, it takes up Nadal’s story in a largely present tense of early 2024 where he’s not […]
